env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

env GOEXPERIMENT=nologosfastcgo,nosimd

logos run .
stdout '^C types: 10 26 42$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt
logos eject -o $WORK/out
cd $WORK/out
env GOEXPERIMENT=
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1273/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt

-- go.mod --
module example.com/cgotypes

go 1.27

-- logos.toml --
[build]
cgo = "allow"

-- main.lgo --
package main

/*
typedef unsigned long word;
*/
import "C"

import "fmt"

// An ordinary local type remains its own type during lowering.
type Local int

func main() {
	a := [2]C.int{1, 2}
	b := [2]C.int{3, 4}
	x := a + b
	c := [2]C.word{5, 6}
	d := [2]C.word{7, 8}
	y := c + d
	e := [2]Local{9, 10}
	f := [2]Local{11, 12}
	z := e + f
	fmt.Println("C types:", x[0]+x[1], y[0]+y[1], z[0]+z[1])
}
